notes: Proof House on Ethereum mainnet, first drop ARTIFACTS (THE SOURCE by auction first, then 255 editions). No fungible token or pool. IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) is the existing ERC-20 buyers may pay with for plain SVG collections. 7 contracts: ArtifactsPiece (the 24 KB locked implementation every piece is a runtime copy of) is not in this launch, so the one launch transaction stays under EIP-7825's 2^24 gas cap (the 8 needed about 20.9M gas); the curator deploys it right after, from launch.piece.json, with the launched KeyProof, and connects it once with ArtifactsFactory.setPieceImplementation and ArtifactsSource.setPieceImplementation (neither sale can open without it). BrokerPass: 100 free passes, claimed with an ARTIFACTS piece or an identity.md seat (0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d); holders are Proof House brokers. BrokerPass claims are one per wallet, ever. BrokerPass claims open at a start time the factory's owner sets once (setClaimsOpenAt). SubmissionReviews: advisory reviews of artist submissions, one voice per identity.md seat and per claimed ARTIFACTS piece, frozen once the curator decides; no owner. ImdBuybackBurner is not in this launch either: the curator deploys it right after, from launch.burner.json, and connects it with ArtHouse.setBuybackBurner. After deployment the owner deploys ArtifactsPiece and calls setPieceImplementation on ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource, calls ArtHouse.setBrokerPass, approves the artist, registers ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource as sale modules and module collections, sets THE SOURCE's split to 15/0/85, configures VRF, calls ArtStorage.setHouse, calls ArtHouse.setBuybackBurner(ImdBuybackBurner), and at launch BrokerPass.setClaimsOpenAt.
